_name: Long-Term BTC Cycle Strategy — Grid V3 (Prudence Mode)
_description: V3 adds halving-relative prudence tiers to V2 execution. Since top indicators (Mayer>2.4, Pi Cycle) are fading as each cycle is progressively front-run by institutional money, V3 replaces threshold-based top detection with timing-based distribution anchored to the known halving→top window (~534d average across C1-C3). During BULL, BTC target steps down 90%→75%→50% at 400d/480d post-halving. Sacrifices 13% absolute return vs V2 in exchange for -26pp max drawdown and +39% Calmar ratio. Critical for C4 where top indicators may be fully silent.

_backtest.aggregation: 1m → daily OHLCV (day high for top signals, day low for bottom signals)
_backtest.vs_V2: +16.7% vs +34.7% in V2  (1661 trades vs 211)  MaxDD -26pp  Calmar +39%
_backtest.prudence_rationale: C3 peak Mayer Multiple was only 1.86 (vs 2.92 and 3.79). Pi Cycle Top never fired. C3 was frontrun: BTC made new ATH ($73K) BEFORE the Apr-2024 halving — unprecedented. If C4 repeats, all threshold-based top signals will be silent. The halving→top window (526d/548d/529d avg=534d) is the only reliable a priori signal remaining.

_vs_V2: Same regime detection. Same V2 execution in T0 (<400d post-halving). Adds progressive distribution near expected top: T1 800d→3% rebound/15% tranche/75% target, T2 >480d→2% rebound/10% tranche/50% target.

top_signals._comment: Any one fires after min_bull_days in BULL → switch to BEAR. Note: both signals are fading (C3: MM peak only 1.86, Pi Cycle silent). Prudence mode provides timing-based distribution as fallback.

bottom_signals._comment: Any one fires after min_bear_days in BEAR → switch to BULL. Both signals remain reliable across all 3 cycles.

execution._comment: V2 base execution. Prudence tiers override target/rebound/tranche in BULL based on days since last halving.

prudence._comment: Halving→top avg: 526d/548d/529d = 534d. Tiers anchored at 75% and 90% of window. In each tier, BTC target steps down and distribution triggers tighten. Only active in BULL regime.

tier1._note: Caution: start distributing toward 75% BTC target

tier2._note: High-risk: accelerate distribution toward 50% BTC target

_comparison.tradeoff: V3 gives up 13% absolute return vs V2 in exchange for -26pp MaxDD and +39% Calmar. Recommended when: (a) investor cannot tolerate 80%+ drawdowns, (b) top indicators are expected to fail (C4 scenario), or (c) as a live overlay until C4 top timing becomes clearer.
